justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/detector/Detector.java and core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/detector/PDF417DetectorResult.java; this package contains only those 2 classes. The only direct main-source client I found is core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/PDF417Reader.java, which imports Detector and PDF417DetectorResult. Inside the target package, Detector/PDF417DetectorResult depend only on shared core types (BinaryBitmap, DecodeHintType, NotFoundException, ResultPoint, BitMatrix); these are widely reused across the codebase, with 12, 30, 53, 39, and 44 source files importing them respectively. That gives no evidence the package depends on less-stable packages, so Unstable Dependency is not present.
